main_text.head: Tertium perfectum tempus.
main_text.l: Ε' αὐ πεπώμαι, εἰ positus fuerim, πεφῆς, πεφῇ τω.
main_text.head: Plus quam perfectum tempus.
main_text.l: Ε' πετύμμην, verberatus fueram, ἐπετύψο, ἐπετύπτω.
ἐπετύμμεσθα, ἐπετύφθε, πετυμμένοι ἦσαν, per circunlocutionem.
main_text.p: Si autem tertia singularis desinat in τ purum tertia pluralis exit in ντ: ut,
main_text.l: Ε' πεθέμην, positus fueram, ἐπέθεσο, ἐπέθετο.
main_text.head: Primum indefinitum tempus.
main_text.l: Ε' τύφθην, verberatus fui, ἐτύφθης, ἐτύφθη.
Sic ἐπείθην, positus fui, ἐπείθης, ἐπείθη.
main_text.head: Unde formatur primum indefinitum tempus?
main_text.p: A' tertia persona singulari perfecti, consona à principio remota, vocali verò, vel diphthongo initio fer-

page.notes: Greek paradigm lines are small and degraded in the scan. Accents, breathings and some letters in the verb forms are doubtful; the Greek is transcribed as best read and is not certain letter by letter. The line "Ε' χύμην, ἔχυσο, ἔχυτο" and the following "δεδόμην" line are the least certain. Printed "Ε'" stands for ἐάν. The first Greek line at the top of the page is cut off at the upper edge, so it is a fragment and may be incomplete. The gathering signature "m 2" is at the foot right. No catchword is visible. The word "fer-" at the line end continues on the next page.
